canonical.title: A Dreis weekend, anchored on dinner at Waldhotel Sonnora

sources.title: Waldhotel Sonnora
sources.claim: Twenty individually designed rooms; Sonnora gourmet breakfast included; Wittlich and Bernkastel-Kues are the nearest towns.

sources.title: Sonnora Forest Suite
sources.claim: Forest Suite ~90 m², separate living/sleeping, sauna, terrace, €595/night.

sources.title: Michelin Guide — Waldhotel Sonnora
sources.claim: Waldhotel Sonnora carries three Michelin stars in Dreis, Rheinland-Pfalz.

sources.title: Travels for Stars — Sonnora
sources.claim: The most remote of Germany's ten three-Michelin-starred restaurants.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Sonnora
sources.claim: Ranked #1 of 1 hotel in Dreis; rooms tastefully renovated 2020-21.

sources.title: Eifel Tourist Board — Sonnora
sources.claim: Flagship culinary destination in the Eifel/Mosel transition zone.

sources.title: Schloss Lieser
sources.claim: Castle hotel on the Mosel riverbank in Lieser.

sources.title: Marriott Autograph — Schloss Lieser
sources.claim: Restored 19th-century castle on the Mosel.

sources.title: Romantik Jugendstilhotel Bellevue
sources.claim: Dating from 1903; 4★S Art-Nouveau hotel on the Mosel in Traben-Trarbach.

sources.title: Bellevue Standard Double
sources.claim: Standard Doppelzimmer from €164/night incl. breakfast and spa.

sources.title: Weinromantikhotel Richtershof
sources.claim: Stylish 4★S hotel within a winery estate in Mülheim an der Mosel.

sources.title: Hotel Molitors Mühle
sources.claim: Former mill in the Salmtal valley with five lakes and a 700 m² spa.

sources.title: Märchenhotel
sources.claim: Fairy-tale themed hotel on the Mosel, Bernkastel-Kues.

sources.title: Bernkastel Marktplatz
sources.claim: Medieval heart of the old town surrounded by half-timbered houses.

sources.title: Burg Landshut
sources.claim: 13th-century summer residence of the Archbishops of Trier above Bernkastel.

sources.title: Burg Landshut Express
sources.claim: Vintage yellow shuttle bus from Am Gestade to the castle, hourly April-October.

sources.title: Traben-Trarbach sights
sources.claim: Art-Nouveau Brückentor by Bruno Möhring, Grevenburg ruin, Mont Royal fortress.

sources.title: Traben-Trarbach Underworld
sources.claim: Around 1900 the second-largest wine-trading town in Europe after Bordeaux; underground cellar tours.

sources.title: Manderscheid Castles
sources.claim: Twin medieval castle ruins facing each other across the Lieser river; Oberburg free year-round.

sources.title: Burgenklettersteig Manderscheid
sources.claim: The only via ferrata in Rheinland-Pfalz; ~4.6 km, three stages, includes a 60 m rope bridge.

sources.title: Daun & the Maare
sources.claim: Three Daun maars (Gemündener, Weinfelder, Schalkenmehrener); Eifelsteig and Lieserpfad pass through.

sources.title: Dronketurm
sources.claim: 11-metre tower on Mäuseberg between Weinfelder and Schalkenmehrener Maar; 43 steps to a panorama of all three maars.

sources.title: Maare-Mosel-Radweg
sources.claim: ~58 km cycle path from Daun to Bernkastel-Kues on a former railway line, asphalted with gentle gradients.

sources.title: Markus Molitor — opening hours
sources.claim: Klosterberg vinothek in Zeltingen-Rachtig open daily 10:00-17:00.

sources.title: VisitMosel — Dr. Loosen
sources.claim: Tastings by appointment Mon-Sat 10:00-17:00; closed Sundays.

sources.title: Weingut Dr. Loosen
sources.claim: Family-owned for over 200 years at St. Johannishof in Bernkastel-Kues.

sources.title: Weingut Schloss Lieser
sources.claim: Thomas Haag, Winzer des Jahres 2015; eight VDP.Grosse Lage sites.

sources.title: Weingut Fritz Haag
sources.claim: Brauneberg estate farming 19.5 ha including 8 ha in Grosse Lage Juffer / Juffer Sonnenuhr.

sources.title: Selbach-Oster
sources.claim: Riesling tastings by request in Zeltingen-Rachtig; closed during harvest until end of October.

sources.title: Wikipedia — J.J. Prüm
sources.claim: Founded 1911, led by Dr Katharina Prüm; 13.5 ha exclusively Riesling on slate slopes.

sources.title: Mythos Mosel 2026
sources.claim: 29-31 May 2026, 116 winegrowers across 29 stations between Kesten and Zeltingen-Rachtig.

sources.title: Middle Moselle Wine Festival
sources.claim: Bernkastel-Kues, 3-7 September 2026; 300 m wine route with 20+ vendors.

sources.title: vitis live 2026
sources.claim: International viticulture technology show, 1-2 July 2026, Piesport/Mosel.

sources.title: Säubrennerkirmes Wittlich
sources.claim: Third weekend of August — ~100,000 visitors blocking the Wittlich market square.

sources.title: Vulkaneifel-Therme Bad Bertrich
sources.claim: Closed 15-28 June 2026 for maintenance; steam bath in renovation through early September.

sources.title: CiE 2026 — Trier
sources.claim: Computability in Europe, 27-31 July 2026 at Trier University; €200 early-bird.

sources.title: WRO Deutschlandfinale 2026
sources.claim: World Robot Olympiad German final, 19-20 June 2026, SWT-Arena Trier; ~150 teams.

sources.title: Rome2rio — Dreis ↔ Traben-Trarbach
sources.claim: 31.2 km / ~26 min by car.

sources.title: Rome2rio — Dreis ↔ Bernkastel-Kues
sources.claim: 22.8 km / 19 min by car; taxi €55-70.

sources.title: Rome2rio — Dreis ↔ Lieser
sources.claim: 18.1 km / 16 min by car; taxi €45-60.

sources.title: Rome2rio — Dreis ↔ Mülheim
sources.claim: 17.6 km / 16 min by car.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Dreis
sources.claim: Bernkastel-Wittlich district at the edge of the Wittlich Depression on the river Salm.

sources.title: Marienburg
sources.claim: Perches on a peninsula inside the 14 km Mosel loop above Pünderich/Zell.

sources.title: Maarmuseum Manderscheid
sources.claim: Volcanic maar story with a 45 M-year-old Eckfeld primeval horse skeleton.

sources.title: Bernkastel Marktplatz (Altstadt)
sources.claim: The Spitzhäuschen is a 1416 slanted half-timbered house; small wine tavern today.
